name: I Can Fix Him!
source:
After getting into huge debt and completing a shitty online coaching course, you decide to start coaching other men to become rich and pay off your debts. Will you be able to shape your first customer into the man he wants to be?

Or...

Will you romance him instead?

[From [url=https://meowdy-nio.itch.io/i-can-fix-him]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在背负巨额债务并完成一门糟糕的在线辅导课程后，你决定开始辅导其他人致富并还清债务。你能把你的第一位顾客塑造成他想成为的人吗？

或者…

你会和他恋爱吗？

[来自[url=https://meowdy-nio.itch.io/i-can-fix-him]itch.io[/url]]
